title: ICES 2026 490: LEMS-A3 system TVAC plan. 2.5 W heat limit. Battery capacity 940.8 Wh at -30 C measured. Predicted night 849.5 Wh. Leak not yet measured.
quote_limit: the thermal system is limited to 2.5 Watts of heat during the lunar night
quote_will_measure: The test will measure the nighttime heat leaks for the bus and seismometers
quote_capacity: The flight battery has a measured energy capacity at -30°C of 940.8 Wh
quote_predict: the maximum predicted energy consumption for a nominal lunar night, including systematic errors set at three standard deviations, is 849.5 Wh
note: Do not paste 940.8 onto the 640 Wh TCS allocation. Do not treat 849.5 or 2.318 as a measured A3 leak. January 2026 checkout used the TRL-6 development unit plus GSE.
